test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: How much wage compensation per trainee is provided under the PM DAKSH Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 3000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PM DAKSH Yojana is an initiative launched by the Government of India to provide training and employment opportunities to the youth of the country.**
 
• **Rs 3000** is the wage compensation per trainee is provided under the PM DAKSH Yojana
 
• The scheme aims to provide training
